attempt_summaries.rationale: Added automountServiceAccountToken false, securityContext with runAsNonRoot, non-zero runAsUser, allowPrivilegeEscalation false, readOnlyRootFilesystem true, dropped all capabilities, added CPU/memory requests and limits (memory limit >=1Gi). Kept image, JAVA_OPTS, ports, Service selector unchanged.

final_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: billing
  namespace: billing
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: billing
      tier: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: billing
        tier: api
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: billing
          image: registry.example.com/billing:3.4.1
          env:
            - name: JAVA_OPTS
              value: "-Xms512m -Xmx768m -XX:+UseG1GC"
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: billing
  namespace: billing
spec:
  selector:
    app: billing
    tier: api
  ports:
    - name: web
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
